stepBody:
To choose the most optimal λ, Namjoon uses 5-fold cross-validation to train $$5$$ models and stores the appropriate root-mean square error for each fold and λ. Given the collected statistics about the cross-validation error for each model, help Namjoon choose the value of λ (among the $$5$$ listed) that is the best to use with exponential regularization.

A. λ $$=$$ $$0.001$$
B. λ $$=$$ $$0.01$$
C. λ $$=$$ $$0.1$$
D. λ $$=$$ $$1$$
E. λ $$=$$ $$10$$
